series_title: The Ancient World of Ice and Fire

visual_cadence_rule: 30 images per minute (1 image every 2.0 seconds)
visual_style_standard: Adult cinematic physically realistic 3D historical reconstruction & live-action 65mm location cinematography (ARRI Alexa 65, Panavision Primo primes, Kodak Vision3 500T grade: warm sandstone highlights, deep cerulean Summer Sea, lush emerald pastures, muted volcanic stone)
visual_qc_note: Six frames (IMG0221, IMG0223, IMG0224, IMG0227, IMG0228, IMG0230) passed visual review, are 1376x768 sRGB PNGs, and were uploaded with matching Drive/local MD5s. Four frames require rerender: IMG0222 reads as a skeletonised bone joint rather than living armor ring; IMG0225 opens onto a full landscape through a round cave mouth instead of a sliver of daylight; IMG0226 uses rectangular longhouse forms instead of round dry-stone basalt dwellings; IMG0229 shows a modern-looking field grid and tracks.
